title: King Solomon, the son of King David, and a forefather of Jesus Christ, is a Jew and Black man!
cleanTitle: King Solomon, the son of King David, and a forefather of Jesus Christ, is a Jew and Black man!
segments: King Solomon the son of King David was
renowned for his unmatched wisdom and
extraordinary wealth when the Queen of
Sheba visited to test his reputation she
was amazed by his wisdom and the
Grandeur of his kingdom she brought
lavish Gifts of gold spices and precious
stones each year Solomon received 666
talents of gold about 35 tons along with
treasures like silver Ivory and exotic
animals from his Fleet his kingdom
flourished with luxurious items
including gold Shields and an ivory
throne overlaid with gold but Solomon
wasn't just wealthy he was wise Beyond
Compare he spoke 3,000 Proverbs composed
1,5 songs and had knowledge of plants
animals birds and even fish kings and
people from all over the world traveled
to hear his god-given wisdom making him
the greatest king of his time for a more
in-depth understanding of his wisdom
refer to wisdom of Solomon 7:15 to 22
